title: The Joyless Pantomime of Optimizing Ennui - Whatfinger News Quick Hits
text:
The joyless pantomime of optimizing our alienation is not a substitute for authentic fulfillment.
We all know that geopolitics, the stock market, AI, the unemployment rate and all the rest of what’s presented as “explaining” everything is “important,” but all these analytic abstractions ignore what we actually experience. This divide between what we’re told we should be experiencing and what we are actually experiencing is what I call the politics of experience, a term coined by R.D. Laing in the 1960s.
Read Full Article: https://www.lewrockwell.com/2026/08/charles-hugh-smith/the-joyless-pantomime-of-optimizing-ennui/
